all_candidates.topic: Should India offer E10/pure petrol alongside E20?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government defended E20 petrol, but motorists complain about no price reduction and desire other fuel options (July 27, 2026; July 30, 2026; August 2, 2026; July 10, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is E20 petrol truly saving consumers money?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government stated E20 prevented petrol from reaching Rs 125/litre when crude prices were high (August 1, 2026), amidst public debate on its cost-effectiveness.

all_candidates.topic: Should UPI transactions above Rs 2,000 incur MDR?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government proposed changes allowing a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on select UPI transactions, possibly for payments over Rs 2,000 to large merchants (August 4-5, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will new exam fraud laws truly prevent paper leaks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre introduced a Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill with stricter penalties to address the NEET controversy and exam fraud (July 27, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Are AI-driven IT layoffs justified for efficiency?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's IT sector expects 25,000-35,000 job cuts in 2026 due to AI adoption and restructuring, a topic discussed in recent reports (July 9, 2026, and ongoing).

all_candidates.topic: Should companies prioritize freshers over AI efficiency?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Fresh graduate hiring has fallen across corporate India, with AI-driven redeployment cited as a main reason (August 4, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Are consumer protection mechanisms failing ordinary people?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A LocalCircles survey (July 31, 2026) found 66% of consumers couldn't get assistance for major service issues.

all_candidates.topic: Should politicians use Gen Z slang in Parliament?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Lok Sabha MPs used Gen Z slang during the anti-paper leak bill debate, sparking discussion on parliamentary discourse (July 29, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is AI literacy the most crucial skill for future jobs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: AI literacy is becoming a new industry standard, driving white-collar hiring for AI roles (July 7, 2026, with ongoing discussion).

all_candidates.topic: Are viral online trends distracting Gen Z from duties?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A recent debate questioned if viral trends and online outrage distract Gen Z from civic responsibility (August 6, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should food regulators impose heavier fines for misleading ads?
all_candidates.news_anchor: FSSAI recently issued notices to companies for misleading claims and labelling violations.

all_candidates.topic: Should all cities offer women-only electric bus services?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Chennai introduced more e-buses, including free 'pink' lines for women, by March 2026, as part of ongoing mobility initiatives.

all_candidates.topic: Is India's EV push truly sustainable for all?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's electric vehicle adoption surged to 8.26% in FY 2025-26, supported by schemes like PM E-DRIVE (August 5, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Are AI agents a growing cybersecurity threat?
all_candidates.news_anchor: OpenAI and Anthropic AI agents were implicated in new security breaches, creating fake identities during UK cyber tests (August 5, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should tech giants prioritize AI investment over jobs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Microsoft announced global job cuts to invest more in AI (July 7, 2026), sparking ongoing discussions about tech giants' priorities.

all_candidates.topic: Are stricter GST compliance rules fair to businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New GST rules for 2026 include a 3-year time bar on return filing and 30-day IRN reporting for large businesses (August 5, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will revamped National Consumer Helpline improve redressal?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The National Consumer Helpline (NCH) was revamped with 17 languages and WhatsApp/SMS options (August 5, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Do higher GST collections justify recent rate rationalization?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Gross GST revenue in July 2026 jumped 15.4% to over Rs 2 lakh crore, despite recent rate rationalization (August 2, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will increasing Supreme Court judges improve justice delivery?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Rajya Sabha cleared a Bill to increase the number of Supreme Court judges (August 5, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should India relax tax norms to attract foreign funds?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government proposed easing eligibility norms for offshore funds under the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 (August 3, 2026).
